key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:type:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_words_then_call
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed block in the program data into a buffer whose address is passed on the stack, then makes an indirect call through a stored pointer. It is reached from a routine that prepares that buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:L/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: run_disk_validator_main
description: Program entry point of the file labelled Disk-Validator. It initialises counters and table entries, writes a digit character into a text buffer, and walks several table ranges while making many indirect calls through the library table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:0000
name: clear_state_block_then_setup
description: Zeroes a block of 947 longwords starting at an offset from a base register, stores two values into the state block, then calls the main setup routine and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:016E
name: open_libraries_and_init_display
description: Opens the graphics and layers libraries and the trackdisk device, loads the Amber 9 font, allocates memory and display structures, and returns a distinct numbered error code at the first step that fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:08BA
name: release_flagged_resources
description: Checks a set of status flag bits and, for each flag that is set, calls the matching free routine for its resource. It then clears the status word after the remaining handles are released.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:0B36
name: build_six_entry_index_table
description: Allocates a block and runs an init routine, then walks a packed sequence of six length-prefixed entries, recording each entry's pointer and size in a six-slot table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:0BCC
name: toggle_open_closed_map_tile
description: Finds a matching tile near a given map position and rewrites the surrounding cells into the open or closed form taken from a 17-entry table. The referenced strings are open and closed status labels, and the routine returns whether a tile was changed.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:0EEE
name: run_game_setup_and_loop
description: A very large routine that sets up screen buffers and resource tables, draws the page graphics, and then runs a long main loop calling many helpers. It refers to the screen names hiscreen and page0 and compares some values against AmigaDOS hunk type codes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:5716
name: advance_y_until_position_free
description: Stores a new X and Y position for an entity after recording how far it moved from its previous position. When a flag argument is set it also updates a table index from the position bits, then increases Y one unit at a time until a check reports the spot free.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:57FA
name: classify_position_terrain_and_region
description: Looks up a terrain class for the current position by scanning a range table and rejects the class when the position falls outside an allowed band. It calls a handler when the class changes and checks a 22-entry table of region rectangles to set a state code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:5B1C
name: update_state_from_table
description: Combines a byte from a table entry with a value fetched through a helper and stores the result. When a second table value differs from the stored one, it stores the new value, sets a timer and flag, and calls a routine with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:5B9E
name: map_entity_to_view_coordinates
description: Calls two helpers to read the entity's current coordinates, then passes them through a mapping routine with a fixed offset to produce two view coordinates.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:5BF0
name: find_free_spot_near_center
description: Tries up to fifteen random offsets around a reference point to find an unoccupied position. When a spot is found it records the coordinates and a kind code in an entry; for one special kind it uses fixed coordinates, and it returns failure when no spot is free.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:5DE0
name: retire_expired_table_entry
description: For an entry chosen from a table by a random index, it retires the entry once its counter has run out and its kind is not one of two excluded values. It resets the entry's fields, plays a sound for one kind, adjusts a related counter, and calls a helper that performs a further update when the flag argument is zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:5EAA
name: reset_actor_slot_for_kind
description: Chooses a slot type from a parameter, then reloads the matching resource if the current kind differs. It sets the slot's coordinates from table values indexed by a random value and clears its state fields to defaults.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:5F88
name: initialize_actor_defaults
description: Sets a long list of fields in a shared state block to fixed starting values, including zeroes and two constant position words, and runs a setup routine when the argument is zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:637C
name: compute_rect_bounds_from_offset
description: Computes paired rectangle coordinates from a parameter and a random value, with each coordinate formed by subtracting from a constant, and then passes the bounds to a helper that builds them.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:642C
name: select_zone_table_entry
description: Picks a numbered entry from a table based on whether the current position lies inside a fixed screen band and on a state value, then passes that entry to a playback routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:6534
name: update_current_zone_index
description: Computes a zone index from the current map position, calls a helper when the position is inside a range, and stores the index. When the index changes it refreshes related state and queries a structure to update further fields.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:6660
name: swap_display_buffers
description: Swaps the front and back buffer pointers stored in program data, copies the new buffer's first two words into a working record, then calls three routines to update the display and its state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:66B6
name: open_input_device_handler
description: Creates a reply port and opens the input device by name. If either step fails it returns zero; on success it prepares an input request block, opens the device with it and returns the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:6766
name: initialise_input_request_block
description: Sets a request type code and a handler pointer in an input request block, submits it through three library calls, and then closes the associated port.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:67AC
name: collect_flagged_entries_into_slots
description: Collects up to twelve entries from a record table whose flag bit is set, storing their indexes and calling a helper for each. It then fills any remaining slots up to twelve, alternating between two fixed positions, and calls a drawing routine for each.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:68CA
name: draw_indexed_entry_by_mode
description: Derives a display type code for an indexed entry from the current mode value, using fixed codes for two modes and a table lookup for the rest. It passes that code with a position to a drawing routine chosen by the entry's low bit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:6A66
name: dispatch_mode_event_and_redraw
description: Dispatches on the current mode and an event code. For one event it redraws 31 rows of graphics through a blit routine and advances the mode, and for another it sets a new mode and calls the matching handler.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:7ED2
name: poll_position_test_until_match
description: Runs a step routine repeatedly, up to twenty-five times, until a position test returns five. When the test succeeds early, it passes the position to a helper and runs a follow-up step.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:7F18
name: signal_position_and_follow_up
description: Passes the stored position to a helper with a fixed code of one, then runs the same follow-up step used after a successful position test.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:7F40
name: set_state_if_not_locked
description: If a lock bit in a flag byte is clear, stores the given value as the current state, clears a related byte, and calls a routine to apply the change.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:7F60
name: load_status_bytes_from_source
description: Reads seven pairs of bytes and six further bytes from a source routine into two arrays and one shared field, choosing that field's value from a parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:800E
name: wait_until_counter_reaches_ten
description: Repeatedly calls a step routine while a 16-bit counter in the state block is below ten, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8022
name: refresh_changed_entry_fields
description: For the entry selected by a counter below ten, compares each of its fields with a cached copy. It calls a setter for every field that changed and updates the cache.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:82A0
name: apply_entry_when_enabled
description: If a flag bit is set, passes a stored value for the given index, halved, together with the second argument to a routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:82E0
name: init_four_buffers_from_state
description: Calls a routine three times to initialise three buffers with the same count, loads a pointer from a table selected by a state index, and initialises a fourth buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8334
name: store_argument_in_record_field
description: Stores the single stack argument into offset four of the record pointed to by an address register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:833A
name: process_input_record_into_ring
description: Processes one record in a loop. A type-one record writes a character from a lookup table into a 128-entry ring buffer and advances its head, and a type-two record emits a code when a flag word changes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8390
name: queue_flag_change_code
description: Writes one code into a 128-entry ring buffer when a flag bit changes between two stored words, then advances the buffer head.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:83BC
name: queue_grid_position_code
description: Maps a screen position inside a fixed rectangle to a code derived from its row, writes that code into a 128-entry ring buffer, and stores the position word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:84EA
name: pop_byte_from_ring_buffer
description: Returns the next byte from a 128-entry ring buffer and advances its tail, or returns zero when the buffer is empty.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8514
name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Advances a 32-bit state with a multiply-and-add step and returns a value mixed from its high and low bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:852C
name: mask_random_with_parameter
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns its result ANDed with the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8534
name: random_bit_flag
description: Returns the lowest bit of a fresh pseudo-random value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:853E
name: random_two_bit_value
description: Returns a fresh pseudo-random value masked to its two lowest bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8548
name: random_three_bit_value
description: Returns a fresh pseudo-random value masked to its three lowest bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8552
name: random_six_bit_value
description: Returns a fresh pseudo-random value masked to its six lowest bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:855C
name: random_low_byte_value
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns only the low byte of its result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8566
name: combine_random_modulo_parameter
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator, takes its low 16 bits modulo the low 16 bits of the parameter, and returns that remainder packed together with the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:857A
name: advance_random_then_library_call
description: Advances the pseudo-random generator and then calls a library routine at a fixed table offset, returning the register pair unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:85A6
name: format_decimal_number_right_aligned
description: Writes a 16-bit value as decimal digits into a ten-position text buffer, filling the unused leading positions with spaces.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:85AE
name: format_decimal_digits_into_buffer
description: Writes a number as decimal digits from the end of a buffer toward its start. A zero value leaves the remaining leading positions as spaces.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:85CA
name: clear_text_buffer_with_spaces
description: Fills a text buffer with space characters, counting down from a given index to zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:85F6
name: sweep_grid_with_callbacks
description: Runs three nested counting loops over a grid of 17 by 16 cells with five inner steps, calling routines through function pointers at every step. It makes extra calls when the outer counter exceeds nine and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:86FA
name: print_text_string_with_codes
description: Walks a null-terminated string. A special marker byte triggers a separate routine call, and each run of other characters is measured and passed to a text output routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:874E
name: lookup_cell_nibble_for_position
description: Converts two position words into a cell index, looks up a map value and a bit mask for it in two tables, and returns the high nibble of the matching entry or zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8756
name: lookup_cell_nibble_from_registers
description: Performs the same map and mask lookup as its sibling routine, taking the two position words from registers instead of the stack, and returns the matching high nibble or zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:87EE
name: call_and_pop_stack_slot
description: Calls a routine from the function table, then decrements a stack-pointer counter in the state block by four.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8810
name: call_and_reset_stack
description: Calls the same table routine, then subtracts a stored base value plus four from a stack-pointer counter in the state block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8838
name: run_nineteen_update_steps
description: Calls one routine with a state value, then calls nineteen more routines in sequence and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:88F0
name: run_six_update_steps
description: Calls six routines in sequence and returns without doing any other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:890A
name: copy_source_words_to_buffers
description: Copies sixteen rows of 16-bit words from a source pointer derived from a parameter into several destination buffers, reading two source words per iteration.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8964
name: stub_return_only
description: Decodes to three instructions that only return, with no work done. It lies in a gap between known code that decodes as code, and the reference run never executed it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:896E
name: run_single_state_update
description: Calls one routine with a value from the state block and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:89C8
name: run_nineteen_update_steps
description: Calls one routine with a state value, then calls eighteen more routines in sequence, and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8A62
name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing no data work of its own.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8A70
name: iterate_visible_tile_grid
description: Converts two position words into tile coordinates, wrapping them within a 128-unit range and clamping them to fixed maxima, then loops over the surrounding grid cells and calls a per-cell routine for each one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8B30
name: convert_bytes_to_five_bitplanes
description: Reads packed byte data and shifts one bit at a time from each byte into five separate bit-plane buffers, storing each finished word in its plane.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8BC8
name: blit_tile_rows_to_bitplane
description: Copies eight rows of tile words from a source tile into a destination bit plane at an offset computed from the position parameters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8C18
name: compute_map_cell_index
description: Converts two position words into a wrapped map cell offset, combines the cell's byte with the low bits of the position, and returns the result plus a base value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8C84
name: build_viewport_tile_indexes
description: Walks the viewport in steps, converting each position into a map cell index with the same wrapping and clamping as its sibling routines, and stores the indexes in a 16-bit table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8D48
name: decode_run_length_stream
description: Expands a run-length encoded stream into a destination buffer: a negative count repeats the following byte, and a non-negative count copies that many literal bytes. The loop runs only while a stream-active flag is set.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8DC4
name: add_table_scaled_delta_masked
description: When the second argument is below eight, adds a table-scaled version of the third argument to the first and masks the result to fifteen bits. Otherwise it returns the first argument unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8DEE
name: add_scaled_delta_keep_sign
description: Performs the same table-scaled addition as its sibling routine, but keeps the sign bit of the first argument unchanged in the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8E20
name: copy_bit14_into_sign_bit
description: Sets bit fifteen of the value when bit fourteen is set, and clears bit fifteen otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8E30
name: clear_register_sign_bit
description: Returns the value with its sign bit, bit fifteen, cleared.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8E36
name: step_position_toward_target
description: Compares the stored X and Y position with a target and nudges each coordinate one step toward it. A large difference in X snaps it directly to a fixed offset from the target.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8E6E
name: nudge_position_from_registers
description: Performs the same one-step nudge toward a target as its sibling routine, taking the target from registers, and snaps the coordinate when the offset is large.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8E7E
name: nudge_position_to_target
description: Moves the stored X coordinate one unit toward a target when it is far enough away, and nudges the Y coordinate in the same way or snaps it to a fixed offset from the target.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8E8A
name: advance_x_and_adjust_y
description: Moves the stored X coordinate one unit forward when the offset is large enough, then adjusts Y toward its target, snapping it to a fixed offset when the offset is very large.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8EA4
name: adjust_y_toward_target
description: Moves the stored Y coordinate one unit toward a target when the offset is large enough, and snaps it to a fixed offset from the target when the offset is very large.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8EB4
name: step_y_toward_target
description: Moves the stored Y coordinate one unit toward a target when the offset from it exceeds ten in either direction.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8EC0
name: increment_y_when_past_threshold
description: Adds one to the stored Y coordinate when the offset from its target is greater than ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8ED6
name: report_error_unless_two
description: If the argument is not two, shows an error message through three routine calls with constant arguments and a pointer to the error text. Otherwise it returns without doing anything.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8F0E
name: select_threshold_band_index
description: Looks up a byte from a table using the short argument, then compares the argument against a series of thresholds to pick an index from three to ten. It returns that index combined with the input register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8F5A
name: select_direction_index_from_input
description: Chooses a direction index either from the first joystick port's movement bits, through a lookup table, or from a stored horizontal position against threshold bands when a mode flag is set. When the chosen index changes it stores the new value and calls a routine with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8F6E
name: update_direction_index_from_input
description: Makes the same direction index choice as its sibling routine, from joystick bits or position bands, and stores and reports the index only when it changes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:8FC0
name: read_joystick_direction_index
description: Reads the joystick port's movement bits and maps them to a direction index through a lookup table. When the stick is centred it decays a counter that is clamped to the range zero to nine, and it reports the index only when it changes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9012
name: update_clamped_direction_index
description: Subtracts twenty from a stored counter and clamps the result to zero to nine, resetting the counter when it falls outside that range. When the clamped value changes it stores the value and calls a routine with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9026
name: reset_index_to_nine
description: Clears a stored counter, and if the stored index is not nine, stores nine and calls a routine with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9044
name: check_two_stage_value_gate
description: Calls a value routine and, if its result is neither one nor at least ten, calls it again. It returns zero when the second result is neither one nor below eight, and otherwise returns the latest value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9080
name: combine_bitplane_words_by_rows
description: Walks rows and columns of a bitmap in a nested loop, combining source words from several bitplane pointers into each destination word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9112
name: start_blitter_copy_sequence
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then for four table entries programs its modulo, pointer, control and size registers and starts each blit, using a mask derived from the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:91A2
name: configure_blitter_registers_with_args
description: Writes a fixed control value to the blitter control register and clears a second control register and a modulo register. It then loads the two arguments into the destination pointer and the size register, and returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:91CC
name: program_four_blitter_planes
description: Waits for the blitter, then for four table entries programs its modulo, pointer and size registers from stored values and starts each blit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9286
name: set_blitter_pointers_from_offsets
description: Waits for the blitter if it is busy, then sets the destination and source pointers and the modulo registers from stored offsets before starting a blit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9310
name: blit_four_masked_planes
description: For four table entries, programs the blitter with a fixed control value and a full mask word, then starts a blit for each entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9390
name: blit_four_planes_with_argument
description: Blits four table entries with the same fixed control value and full mask as its sibling routine, while using the argument to select the source for each blit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9414
name: call_through_unresolved_table_entry
description: Makes an indirect call through a table entry in the program data and returns. The decompiler could not recover the jump table behind it, so the call target is unknown.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:94F2
name: call_through_second_table_entry
description: Makes an indirect call through a different table entry in the program data and returns. The decompiler could not recover the jump table behind it, so the call target is unknown.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9BEC
name: compute_offset_sign_codes
description: Computes the horizontal and vertical offsets from an entry's stored position to the given coordinates, unless the fourth argument is six, and derives a sign code for each direction.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9BF6
name: compute_offset_sign_and_notify
description: Performs the same offset and sign computation as its sibling routine, then calls a routine with the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9C32
name: compute_octant_from_offsets
description: From two signed offsets held in registers, derives sign codes and a direction value by comparing the halved offsets, and returns them packed together.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9C40
name: compute_direction_sign_pair
description: Derives two sign and direction codes from the signed offsets held in the registers, using their halved values, and calls three helper routines to finish the calculation.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9CAA
name: set_direction_field_from_codes
description: Sets a field of a record to the sum of two direction codes masked to three bits, negating one code first when a helper reports a flag. It also sets a timer byte to twelve unless the mode argument is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9CB8
name: store_direction_difference_field
description: Sets a field of a record to the difference of two direction codes masked to three bits, and sets a timer byte to twelve unless the mode argument is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9CD4
name: react_to_nearby_entry_kind
description: When a counter is below four and the nearby entry's kind matches one of two codes, it calls a routine with a fixed code. Otherwise it runs the alternative update for the entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9D3A
name: subtract_offset_when_kind_allowed
description: When the entry kind is not one of two excluded codes, subtracts a stored value from a per-entry field and calls a helper to update that field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9D70
name: decrement_entry_field_and_clamp
description: Subtracts a stored value from a per-entry field and clears the field when it becomes negative. It then calls helpers depending on a direction argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9DC4
name: place_entry_at_random_offset
description: Chooses one of three base offsets according to the current direction state, adds a random amount to it, and passes the result to a placement routine. It then checks the entry kind before continuing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9DE8
name: place_entry_at_side_offset
description: Places an entry at a random offset from one of two base values selected by the direction state, then checks the entry kind before continuing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9E06
name: place_entry_at_fixed_base
description: Places an entry at a random offset from a fixed base value, then checks its kind and calls a helper when the direction value is not negative.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9E7A
name: count_entries_of_kind_two
description: Loops over entries from index three up to a limit and counts those of kind two, and among them those whose sub-kind is fifteen.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9E8A
name: tally_kind_two_subtypes
description: Loops over the entries and tallies kind-two entries whose sub-kind is fifteen into one counter and those whose sub-kind field is five into a second counter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9EA0
name: tally_subtypes_and_check
description: Loops over the entries, counting those with sub-kind fifteen and those with a five-valued field, and then compares a stored value to decide whether to continue.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9EB8
name: resolve_entry_counters_into_action
description: Counts kind-five entries and then walks the remaining entries. Depending on the counters and a stored value it calls a helper with a global text pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9EE4
name: show_battle_result_messages
description: Shows one of a group of battle result messages chosen by two counters and a threshold, calling a helper with the message text for each one. The referenced text is a short battle-result phrase.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9EFC
name: report_enemy_retreat_kill_counts
description: Prints one of two status lines, one for enemies retreating and one for enemies killed in battle, selected by counters and a threshold. When a flag is set it calls a further report routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:9FA2
name: test_position_against_entries
description: Tests a position first with a helper check and then by scanning the entity table, returning a nonzero code on a hit or zero when nothing matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A010
name: find_nearest_eligible_entry
description: Scans the entries for one that is not the reference entry, is not kind five and does not have sub-kind fifteen, and returns a code for the first match or zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A016
name: scan_entries_for_eligible_target
description: Walks the entries for an eligible target, skipping the reference entry, entry index one, kind-five entries and sub-kind fifteen entries, and reports the first one it finds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A0BA
name: scan_entries_for_other_targets
description: Walks the entries after a given index, skipping the reference entry, entry index one and entries of the excluded kinds, and returns zero when the list ends.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A0CE
name: scan_kind_one_entries
description: Scans entries from index one up to the entry count and, for each kind-one entry that passes a sub-kind check when the flag argument is zero, updates a counter. It returns its second argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A0DE
name: find_closest_entry_within_range
description: Scans the entries for the one nearest a reference entry, keeping the smallest distance seen, and stores its index when that distance is closer than the reference entry's range field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A142
name: compute_entry_distance
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances between two entries' stored positions and returns a combined measure of them.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A1C0
name: step_if_within_double_limit
description: When the first value is at most twice the second, calls two helper routines. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A1CC
name: run_two_helper_steps
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A1DE
name: try_move_entry_to_offset
description: Computes two coordinates for an entry from table values and the given offsets, tests them with a helper, and stores them when the test passes. It returns whether the test succeeded.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A26C
name: set_entry_position_words
description: Stores two position words in the table slot of the entry selected by a kind code and returns one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A290
name: apply_byte_record_to_list
description: Reads four bytes from a per-index record, stores a long word in a list node, and passes the values together with fixed arguments to a drawing routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A368
name: select_mode_parameter_and_draw
description: Chooses a numeric parameter from the current mode value and a flag, computes coordinates for an entity from it, and calls helpers to draw it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[h transformer][tr sp]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[h Transformer][tr Sp].adf:fmain:0:A56E
name: fill_random_value_table
description: Fills a 32-entry table with random values below 4096 and passes the table to a display routine, repeating this 32 times with a short wait between passes.
